panels.title: Lead to conversation
panels.description: metric_daily.lead_to_conversation_rate; cohort-anchored, recent days keep changing until the window matures (docs/design/metrics.md).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS "lead_to_conversation_rate" FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='lead_to_conversation_rate' AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Volumes: enquiries, leads accepted, credits consumed/refunded
panels.description: Context for the rates. Credit refunds must follow the 72h auto-refund promise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, metric, value FROM metric_daily WHERE metric IN ('leads_accepted','credits_consumed','credits_refunded','enquiries_created') AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, dimension AS category, value FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='auto_refund_rate' AND dimension<>'' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day
